newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Potash Corp paper rating.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Potash Corp paper rating.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Friday that it confirmed its rating for Potash Corp of Saskatchewan Inc's commercial paper at R-1 (low) with a stable trend.

DBRS said Potash Corp's rating was put under review following two acquisition announcements -- the US$1.2 billion purchase of Arcadian Corp and the assumption of about US$550 million of Arcadian debt.

"The favourable outlook for the North American farm sector should provide strong cash flows for the company, which will help reduce net debt levels to more reasonable levels in the medium term," DBRS said.
The rating agency said Potash Corp's US$164 million purchase of a 51 percent stake in Kali + Salz is expected to have a minor net cash impact.
